status: documentation example for KICADROUTE-91 (AGENTEE-388); no agent-ee code reads this file. tests/test_routing_policy_contract.py checks it against the adapter constants

sources.agent_ee: 81e387ee (AGENTEE-450 re-pin base; contract first written at f06b30bc)

consumes.copper_ownership: builtin process-PASS results only: the kicad-route/copper-ownership/1 pointer, bound to the retained validate/copper-ownership.json bytes; replay_authority false, never graded

request_example.pour_area_loss_pct_note: never stated in configuration: derived per routing turn by layer_policy_derivation (AGENTEE-260) from an agent-ee.via-budget/2 pilot; null here means unknown, not zero

pod_policy.board: expanded telemetry pod, 90 x 65 mm, 4 copper layers; native probe of placement-seed-microsd/base-seed.kicad_pcb with design-rules/board-setup.kicad_pro and telemetry-pod.kicad_dru

values.enforcement: inert: no RF_50 net class exists, /POD_GNSS_RF is Default

values.item: fine-pitch intra-footprint pad clearance U2, U16-U19
values.enforcement: hard; pad-to-pad inside one footprint only, never a routing clearance

layers.stack: F.Cu / In1.Cu / In2.Cu / B.Cu, JLC04161H-7628 (constraints.json:136-140, engineering)
layers.planes: In1.Cu /GND and In2.Cu /+3V3 over the outline (planes.json:4-31; D-PCB-5, constraints.json:146), produced before routing
layers.decision: D-PCB-7 v2 (constraints.json:148, decisions_pending_next_seed): SIG / GND / PWR+SIG / SIG
layers.in1_tracks: none, of any length; through vias may cross In1 except inside the D-PCB-6 corridor
layers.in2_tracks: allowed, any length; the +3V3 pour fills around them, bounded by the derived area-loss bound
layers.short_plane_tracks: no exception exists in the decision or in the adapter: a new In1 track is a disallowed_tracks defect
layers.rf_corridor: D-PCB-6 (constraints.json:147): no tracks or vias on In1/In2 in x 76..88, y 26.5..30.6 mm; needs a native rule area on the input board, not expressible in layer_policy

captured.input_board_and_rules: report.inputs.files (sha256 of every candidate file: .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro, .kicad_dru, .kicad_sch, library tables) and report.inputs.sha256
captured.rule_files_loaded: result.input.rules_files / attempt.rules_files (names only: project, custom_rules, not_loaded)
captured.tool_code: report.tool.commit == PIN; identity_before/after.code (bin, src); PINNED_CODE inside the adapter bytes
captured.engine_and_state: identity_before/after.state (.venv-krt), state_manifest digest, result.backend (version, build, commit, source_sha256)

gaps: no separate placement, netlist or mechanical identity: the board sha256 changes with any edit
no netclass/policy digest independent of the whole .kicad_pro bytes
effective KRT configuration (grid, per-layer costs after defaults, iteration limits, net order, seed, rescue/finalize env defaults, plane-fragility cost) is not in route/1
backend_env is fixed to {}: the KICAD_NET_RESCUE=0 / KICAD_PLANE_FINALIZE=0 pod diagnostics cannot be reproduced through the adapter
no chain root or predecessor: the adapter runs one attempt
RSS, host identity and repair counters are not recorded
kicad-route schemas/ is outside the code pin; agent-ee checks exact key sets itself
